verdict.rationale: Digits documents an llms.txt for its developer docs and a .md markdown mirror of every docs page. Probes confirm both are live: developer.digits.com/llms.txt and overview.md return HTTP 200, and the llms.txt indexes the full API reference. A second product-level llms.txt at digits.com/llms.txt describes the AGL, close workflow, reports and dashboards. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt dump, and the probe got 404s at common OpenAPI paths, so the machine-readable spec's documented location was not confirmed live.
